title: Melodia
tagline: A Decentralized Music NFT Marketplace for Music Composers - Melodia is an NFT marketplace where any independent music composer can launch their albums as an NFT and users will be able to buy from the marketplace.
description:
Description:  
Melodia is an NFT marketplace where any independent music composer can launch their albums as an NFT and users will be able to buy from the marketplace. Music artists will get royalties for every sale.  Why did we build this, Background music plays an important role in making a scene memorable when you're watching a movie. How do movies like Interstellar, Transformers, Inception, and Batman stand out from others? It's the background scores that make scenes more interesting! There are many independent artists who are producing great music scores but still not earning what they deserve.

Objectives: 

1- 😍Enables music composers to sell other music directly to their fans.

2- 🤑Giving royalties to the music composers for every sale.

3- 😎Ownership of the music content..

4- 🥳Music composers can sell their music without the support of music companies. 

5- 🤗Fans can directly support and contribute to the growth of their favorite composers.

Fleek deployment:
https://melodia.on.fleek.co/
how_its_made:
How we built it: 👨‍🔧

Sponsor's Integration: 

1- 🔵Zora Protocol: To drop albums of music composers and APIs to show the minted NFTs in the marketplace and user profile pages.

2- 🔺Livepeer: Storing music scores videos in Livepeer.

3- 🟦web3.Storage: To store music album cover pictures.

4- 🟪Polygon: Deploying the smart contracts.
